items.author: Amjad Masad
items.summary: Mathematicians are going through all five stages of grief — denial, anger, bargaining, depression, acceptance — in a compressed window as AI reaches their turf. His read: we're at the tail end of depression and entering acceptance.
items.summaryZh: 数学家们正在极短的时间内经历悲伤的五个阶段——否认、愤怒、讨价还价、沮丧、接受——因为AI正在闯入他们的领地。他的判断是:我们正处于沮丧的尾声,即将进入接受阶段。

items.author: Sam Altman
items.role: The mission of OpenAI is to ensure that AGI benefits all of humanity
items.summary: The back of the "Navier-Stokes milestone" shirt carries the last line of the chain-of-thought from the solution itself.
items.summaryZh: “纳维-斯托克斯里程碑”T恤的背面印着该解答思维链的最后一行。

items.author: Boris Cherny
items.summary: Says not to sleep on Claude Slides: it's now how he makes slide decks, ending the old routine of googling "iphone frame svg".
items.summaryZh: 他说别小看 Claude Slides:现在他就用它做幻灯片,再也不用像以前那样去搜“iphone frame svg”了。

items.author: Guillermo Rauch
items.summary: Rebuilt the new Roadster demo as a playable, highly accurate simulation that keeps many of the real-life details.
items.summaryZh: 把新款 Roadster 的演示重建成了可玩的高精度模拟,保留了许多现实中的细节。

items.author: Thibault Sottiaux
items.summary: Shares a video on ChatGPT Space made by the actual team working on it — endearingly awkward at times — and asks what people want to see next. Users need to update the app to try it.
items.summaryZh: 分享了一段由 ChatGPT Space 实际团队出镜的视频,有时略显尴尬却很真诚,并询问大家接下来想看到什么。需要更新应用才能体验。

items.author: Swyx
items.summary: Has waited almost a year to launch a new show, sharing behind-the-scenes from the shoot of its latest episode. Separately, he wants the prompts behind a video he calls near-Kurzgesagt clarity of explanation.
items.summaryZh: 筹备近一年的新节目终于上线,并分享了最新一期的拍摄花絮。另外,他想要某个视频背后的提示词,称其讲解清晰度接近 Kurzgesagt 的水准。
